Peter,
**7 weeks.** That’s all the time we have left until Election Day.
**8.** That’s how many polls show Gina neck-and-neck with Greg Abbott in a tied race for Texas Governor.
**$22 million.** That’s the amount Greg Abbott has already spent on television ads and negative attacks to tear down Gina and protect his hold on power.

That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. President Trump is with me in this fight, and he's counting on us to stop South Carolina from sending the most extreme Democrat in the country to the United States Senate. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. I'm ready for the fight, and I'm all in for the United States Senate. But Hollywood and liberal donors from all over the country are lining up to turn South Carolina blue. We must stop the blue wave from coming into South Carolina. My opponent has already raised $13 million, and President Trump and I need you by my side to close that gap. She has the national Democrat machine behind her. No one in South Carolina has fought harder to push gender transition procedures on confused kids than she has. Gun control. Government-run health care. Abortion up until the moment of birth. This agenda is not right for South Carolina. We’re running out of time to combat this agenda. We have less than 8 weeks left before Election Day. Every dollar raised between now and November 3rd determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. FROM: Willis
Subject: Stop caving to Trump.

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. The US Supreme Court just unanimously ruled AGAINST Donald Trump's half-baked and illegal gerrymander in Missouri.
In a rare example of the judicial system delivering fair justice, and with no public dissent, the Supreme Court affirmed the judgment and supremacy of the Missouri Supreme Court to rule on its own elections and DENIED MAGA's emergency appeal to implement their gerrymandered map for the November election.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011syS9KBxFB6MC2kcMV3pzY9pyX_1-ht64_DpCs-yXXjfLVRWpJ8yfpbK4omYMk6rUVveCym2NNhXxSJGspz7Vfh6FKNXXd4iGZstKUT4lxG5YwIQ0FC34EPlHiMN1uLp8O-dCI8GGuNwAgiqyqoTWc2P1lr898Q4XI-5yFtS3e57K3Yf01kdGuqdRAkaHXJ20PNyo_cdKaOaQc12nMKlu6zgWuja4cAxpM7t2D6wPTKvhkcLhpMe8Q==&c=pZoX7N1e52Zji-Ozh8GFj-kyrQcMKGdZSQYNzf02CIXtwfTENzrpYw==&ch=Mn1pAnj6gF4PbpSKaQ4ir2S1PxEyQkf8xT4rIAkzJ951XypCSC5o0w==)

The US Supreme Court just stayed that order. The map drawn up by right wing activists in Washington, DC and dutifully rammed through the Missouri Legislature last year is now suspended.
The stakes of this midterm cannot be overstated: flipping the US Senate will immediately end Trump's stacking of the federal judiciary with MAGA loyalists who issue rulings like Judge Clark just did in Missouri.
That's why Defend Our Courts is fighting on two fronts simultaneously this election: 1) expanding the firewall of state Supreme Courts nationwide, and 2) turning out voters in the states with competitive House and Senate races.

## Middle East Instability Drives Gas Prices Higher
Saudi Arabia [_closed a critical oil pipeline_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQBeDT2B0WHhwbCopt3GXbLS0wQzy7GCxDgnL7lSPlBH87Iz297_25L3dDgeLjt9lRF5-WiDUHLAXPJZuno4MODBQxb8_iUo0WrVmAw8i4Yr1YzFrohctgWqc9IqBoUfeTVKCEVNBuerSjsOAndFZ4cZMCpbQoufJS9tL5lvSVx1Uves6HQXXoemsQBi4AcVxlM3B0VNLZ_U0Uy4Y-vNMLz25Nexv0VsqRG_GrgbmBudbaRbtejut_XdIZXAPzTs4FZGhyaWD-6Jg5jSXDvjr2D9_sS2aBdiqZJQrMh1TZG3eMbEvPslFm5xrNTU1ihPbU7qgUAuVxagb-2A2FT7nyw01fGv4HAAD__-uPj2g) after it was struck by drones launched from Iraq on Saturday. An umbrella group of Iran-backed militias in Iraq [_denied their involvement_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7ohgAWMKimvS5dorrcVs4j1h7MMkUd7-5LzCX45GmtH3_blNN-TM5fEbVwrtvk2F3kem1qhOBz4T77xT5kLH8mxpe5dIESeQMAjphdITzo1fNBnsU7gTAemegnKjB69HD_0SlFHRGK1ma0FKsCmqQUtnvUuYDJmew7knvdJKSmP8hZKKSGCkBqJhHjsjKXHb6uXvxqUtdM-f7UX1Mm9rn8PS2n50-lcH1w6uuJ8IZ3WG2njO1MGVK_4TXLGID61UxBdOYMXIKGalrQenU_JORj94GkFrO5AlTNq5voa0vzlnPgbXGflYkfP3vf1Q2ivA_wAAAP__Po9_Uw), but Iraq’s government confirmed the attacks had originated from its territory. The pipeline strikes follow the [_Houthi’s takeover of Mokha_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI7M4BhcuNiGLttuiQY8xLPPwQhPEuXvnxLpfcGrr3Suzvl3mS7ImbfrX7xRkLVMGz1rJhE6por3yDvvlHmjmu4Sy3ObacYJDDhtvG67CRfhB00WmxhWIqCuodD2gwffDR6aFKLtZ4sO5w4M-nUAiNAP8xlnQ-isbzi8eca3XWuMtf5EsZ2RwJoOiNwyKGsospTj9L_wJonW_CoPOk5LuTU5JJG9qu6PglHBKIkS5_zeFIx7yby8FIyRVtoqKRidGc7OGZ3KXRJXLfhFb5reyyH6I62vWPWPuYKxOULcn5wzV9cra6435M9DI7-M9gjwHQAA__8xGoKl) in Yemen on Thursday. The port city, vital to controlling shipping through the Red Sea, gives Iran another possible foothold in the Middle East. Meanwhile, global crude prices closed at $104 a barrel on Friday, a rise of about 50% since the Iran war broke out in late February. The [_average price of a gallon of gas_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu9CAUhE-DO1bwQLYpKP5fkbtNm9IC87x-EQsW4LX29pFzhbQzmtE383Wf744ipcene6Jta54TnjVia1jm6o5AO-0YKWHdjhbymTx6N4OAngvDpZrd0uiFs3ZdsCsioOrQymE0YNRooNvs4ACkxEvwMGBYvRi8HLVWZvV-MB3Zq08YqaQQWpsbBukdghYKEPtlZFpgoJbL7TtTahuu8Z1fWG5LfnbRbq3tlal_DCYGk_PLteHyGEz_j3rBVwYTpTW6Rjnxgnsujdctnzy6hrXxvdCClVNxiZ-u8P2oG16p2nJ5MzVRYOpDql4pEIPsig37STFS7QemxePpKP7itD---LLwEwAA__8SzIhQ) in the U.S. stands at $4.29, more than $1.30 higher than before the war.
## Trump Calls for Unified Ireland
President Trump said on Saturday that [a unified Ireland](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFu9CAQhJ_G7nyChR9MQfE3113alNZiFnsjbCzM3SlvHzmvkHI00oy-7_MxPZAz78sHbuRbKtNO7zNTa1SnE5-RDz4o807n-myxvPdAAScQYAbhBqkmnBu_aNLYR5-IgFRPXtrRgVOjg371s03kUgpmdEYizskqQzJE0JaCNaJnf-0JJ5UUQmt3oygDEmihgMjMY6cFRW6l3r4K722llL_Li-ptLluf_dracXbqfwf3Du54XAhXdYXaeM7Uwb3V53YMXCnjHoel5DTEUvZAy_DPkh6dM6iCEghSgFbBRotkjFMC--rj8eac-TS202LZkPPvd_ujspeHnwAAAP__6k2ANA) would be "fantastic" during a meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin in Dublin. Before a visit to his Irish golf course, Trump said, _"I don't want to cause any problems, but[I'd love to see it unified](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OhSAUhJ8GOwwe_KOg2MbubrulQTlezwbBAEr27TfuK2w3ySQz-b6v1_wy5Mi_P82BOm9h9liSw5wxzslclk460ZHHtF_ZhuIXXMwMAnouFG_kbNZMN86tqazeEAFlhboZRgVKjgqqXXddsw6DgA16aYbOSLSbUkOHY9cjirEi_ewJ1chGiLZVNdpmMQitkIDYryNrBVrKIdbfgXzecXM_4cZYr-GonN5zPhOTHwwmBlMppV6X9HA8PYPpiQymHK_j5BTRGW-5vRZHnt-UKHOKlHYeTvT8HdzGYKqitmch5yj1A2vF-zDk_v7yPzXdGn4DAAD__3HjfoU). I think it would be a fantastic thing. The U.K. will have something to say about it, obviously."_ When Ireland became a self-governing Roman Catholic-majority country a century ago, a six-county region in the north with a Protestant majority remained part of the United Kingdom. **Whatever happened to the lie detector?** For a machine that promised to [revolutionize truth-telling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7ohgIf5NQXFNulx7pUVgY_aEwYJNrLz9yacrrv_bmflGo_l1X-6eMpX1p9_Q8bMuBY-ekRnb0v0r0k47ZirY04tjPcoDH34BCZOQVii9-MD0xsX4MbonIqAe0amv2YLVs4UxORuNnbSdr1N4BK28vRoz6au2INXsYxjJnX3SKq2kNMZeMKqHRzBSA-IU5sFIjMS1XX5XKpzwmT_1je0S6jZml5j3PugfA9wGuB3Hcekbceq1kC-bX8_YALf_REGlM_GLqZYTSR8RGnquTTypdRaZUERkDFxbFw3XhiyovLGciNhr_qzN70lsPiQq-M-rTahZ2vkKAAPcxubiflDO1Kevwch185T_juZvfv128CcAAP__ryaYNw), the lie detector has had a bumpy ride from midcentury marvel to scientific punchline, and yet it refuses to go away. It started in 1921, when Berkeley police officer John Larson built the first device to track blood pressure, pulse, and respiration during questioning. His protege, Leonarde Keeler, turned it into a showpiece at the 1933 World's Fair and won courtroom testimony two years later. By midcentury, the polygraph had completely captured the public's attention. Employers gave an estimated two million tests a year. Mattel released a [_Lie Detector_ board game](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykk8uWqjoQhp8mznYvSMIlAweJeL-32nQzcYVQSBQMQhTdT39Wex5hT2pS9X2Dqvrj5XEpdamvp5WsoG9zc7xC15ZgLTTHVt4zXesaSn2FtrjbzHTXFFJ5xA72_zjsj0uOUln9gCOVvayfA2AgPei7QcgwIyHDvaKviAJGcpr5mZKYUQ_LlIbgZgCKgYSe7v_6HOYS13EoZR-QuakETB2CAXwVIupApq1pPs5GX20BefkyD2g-lKl6Zb-wtm4R4QiPEB51XfcBqXz9NhEeaftbSRBQ1_VxyLCHyOjYXjpEoqUurbkiLEQjsxJeCItSA8IiAwvKmgZhcZIVIOxrW1VgJSKR4y4x2c8nJKZ0G66I-HaIJ8T3KkHYL2RbIBJpC5UXZHmg_DzIEOEnRHibHDiHXcd_2E3VNPrfWjc1IhFcFcIe4XzLF5xzwcf5z2hz6fR8ENNktWvx3XWfkdu0Hvcv6fhQeUrndbxfx5N93C6nwTPEuvw6bcfpfiA2YpmvlK6i9u_Opq2Z1DThoZnxqajqRDT3ewJOURTnbeOPr1FQBuKwOIAeJdkseKbp3Ywvfvaa7ulT7Tris8-Rcdb12ryeovbYdhq-3PL2Us-5MPPJz_j1lbNtibCHxSI9e_mr0tl5OpsOVFp7U2-5NFrcZuY90AyYOIy-c38wMRObDudu9Dz5mpTX2J1N1ADXzn6zmMHFsNtwewtnX6KQwwl7w0m1HH9mySlNYvUZh83dT0_PuWYOvw9XMVP0caeFHg9vj81sN_8-v6HNOtgOQmdB3fUzGhcLbNufYDbUNf_deYSwFwzspX4fQFzY7pPK3d_HbSt5r-lndafLUrd-gKhzqqQu319n_zEsjz7-LwAA__9BkiBQ) in 1960. CBS debuted _To Tell the Truth_ in 1956, and famous defense attorney F. Lee Bailey even had [his own lie detector show](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu7CAURVeDu7HggYFXUPzG3fw2pYXN85iEMZZhBmX3kbOF1PfqHOl83Ke7jynuj__-Sa6uedqplUS10jkV_wrxiAeluFPZXjXkts80-wk46BvHm5CTX2p806R8F9xKBCQ7csJYBJQWodtcQE0mKB1Wvi4IcwAyHBctvQ3Ga-yiu3gchRScK4U9BTF7AsUlEOnFMsUpxJrP_jPHvW60pu_8prNf8rNLbqv1KEz-YzAyGFtr_eoXmnP-ug4MxseZX0dhMKIxQlqpLCK3AzIYj1zqtQwoldKDMnpAoSRnMHanC0eLKcWiDVP88fQx_SrrH0u9HfwEAAD__9RNegs). Then the science caught up. Courts had been [skeptical since 1923](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O6yAcB0-Du1h82bELite4y2u3tAj8bP9XBBCQWLn9KnuFvcDMaL5u681SoLj_tw-YtqU14qwBraGs1T49ZcoIFFGPZ_PpjHfc7Sq5HC98vgi1WtfohVXbzpsNkFAdjLhOs5zVNMvuMNuo9OatGpQevPLjBI5BCFzVNliMQ0fmw-OzUIJzreceXtwtpOZKAqObmObw1FLpvxPFdmAL7_RC6V16dMEcreXK1D8mFyaX8zx7m22fys7k0lImV5lcXNojfVIvEc-SqiNEByaXnMJ7LzYfXTE-nxQC1fHKNN8flsKvov3xzMvInwAAAP__gth6cw), but the real blow landed in 2003, when a National Academy of Sciences panel found the polygraph's accuracy "well above chance, though well below perfection" and its error rate essentially unknown. CIA spy Aldrich Ames, who passed two polygraphs while committing espionage, didn't help. Still, the machine never disappeared. Congress banned most private employer testing in 1988, but the FBI, CIA, NSA, and the Pentagon can still require polygraphs for security investigations. And you can see it used in scenes like this one from _Meet the Parents_ , where it's more often played for laughs rather than thrills. On the other hand, newer alternatives, including brain imaging, AI, and eye-tracking, have fared no better. The scientific consensus remains that there is no machine that can reliably detect lies. _Ever taken a lie detector test? How did it go? Hit reply and tell us._

For a machine that promised to , the lie detector has had a bumpy ride from midcentury marvel to scientific punchline, and yet it refuses to go away. It started in 1921, when Berkeley police officer John Larson built the first device to track blood pressure, pulse, and respiration during questioning. His protege, Leonarde Keeler, turned it into a showpiece at the 1933 World's Fair and won courtroom testimony two years later. By midcentury, the polygraph had completely captured the public's attention. Employers gave an estimated two million tests a year. Mattel released a in 1960. CBS debuted To Tell the Truth in 1956, and famous defense attorney F. Lee Bailey even had . Then the science caught up. Courts had been , but the real blow landed in 2003, when a National Academy of Sciences panel found the polygraph's accuracy "well above chance, though well below perfection" and its error rate essentially unknown. CIA spy Aldrich Ames, who passed two polygraphs while committing espionage, didn't help. Still, the machine never disappeared. Congress banned most private employer testing in 1988, but the FBI, CIA, NSA, and the Pentagon can still require polygraphs for security investigations. And you can see it used in scenes like this one from Meet the Parents , where it's more often played for laughs rather than thrills. On the other hand, newer alternatives, including brain imaging, AI, and eye-tracking, have fared no better. The scientific consensus remains that there is no machine that can reliably detect lies. ## Round Rock Park Killing Called Random
Williamson County deputies have [charged a 26-year-old man with murder](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2y4yAMhZ8Gd2RAEAMFxTbu7rZbegQoCeMfMpjYydvvOK9wS400n853_v2MP5jnvN7_4kK-vW9lXOnYZmqN6ljLa021xOmJdZryfB42fFcaQUDPheNSjRhb3mnU2CUfRHKyIy-NdeCMlqJ7-AQKwWJSoCgECgLwdiVt3VUlY1zosj9xwkklpVBgL0macBNXNKBVT0YxLSjlVuqlPajRG7fb_Ck71UssSzf7R2vPjak_DAYGw3Ecl2l_0blkMGBtOc7EYDjNGAyx5uUcH2XJMSfied1pa_mOLZeVH6cnLltZeSyvtX349yODAXrHrYw2JHAcrQauY9Dc9S5yjBajUrrvCbrq0_OL2XrDtLgvmOdv1PbbincP_wMAAP__3x2RFw) in the stabbing death of an Austin engineer on a Round Rock park bench. [Andrew James Wimsatt](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QwOHYoKLahe9tuaWEYx8g2WDAv8fv7FfmF185cXd1z_n1NXy7uMT3_ugMNXUueEr7rjkRYppK_UyjZb6cr2xb3FiR3FZxAwMCF5lJNzlN84dS7LphZBC07NHJ8aNBjL0W3GqHvC4w4O_Dao5sDSjEoPfuH8gHuvoum1QktlZRCweMW5Dgv4u5G6NWAo2K9wBAplxutSHi5uuw_-YXl5vPR7WYlOitTfxhYBjb9nLlSezGwrZmBFZqBlcDAflfeCBlYTM-YEAt_R1q533NFThErp8yXfH1ifM2VKm_sGHhMvLgU8sEdkfNbO3zm8IJnLsTAdsWE891U1WFkvXgeLu6fmfRbvS8D_wMAAP__3puRoQ), 62, had just visited his mother at a nearby nursing home when he was attacked shortly before 11 a.m. on Sept. 7. A witness found his body at Chandler Creek Park. A homeowners association camera captured the attack. **Peter** , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me.
I thought so too, _until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the _**next few days.**__

clean_body: Let’s clear the air.| | | | | Peter , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me. I thought so too, until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the next few days. Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Rather than covering for a team on the ground, the fate of more than 10 million people will be decided in November. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline. This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I’m not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I’m asking is a $1 or more donation, which will go right into my campaign's war chest and help me and President Trump take down the Democrat machine come November. As a combat veteran and a patriot - I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I’m eternally thankful for ANY gift you can make. Time is running out. She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them.

| | |
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. **Her name is Alice. **
---
[ Rescue A Child Now](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)

And this is the part most people never hear. **She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. **Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's **IP address**. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. **Alive.**
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)
---
Her trafficker now faces **20 years to life** in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking.
This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting.
Still trapped.
---
[ Rescue A Child Now](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)

And that is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation **exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation 's **mission is clear: **_To stop the sale of God 's children._** The foundation extends the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. clean_body: The power of the people, not the billionaires, must be heard in November. | We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio? Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. body:
I acknowledge there's a very good chance you didn't wake up and think "I am going to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin today. I get it.

| | | | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
Hello. It's Elissa Slotkin.

I acknowledge there's a very good chance you didn't wake up this morning and think "I am going to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin today." I get it.

But that is what I am asking you to do.

I am one of a small number of Democratic Senators who won their race at the same time Donald Trump won that state. Over the final few weeks of the campaign, I am going to do my best to travel and help Democrats in tough campaign ... especially in the midwest.

Here in Michigan, we also have an open Senate seat, a governor's race and a number of other close races. I know how to find voters in so-called "red' areas and can help make the difference -- something that will be important after some tough primaries.

[**If making sure Democrats have a chance of retaking the Senate, the House and supporting candidates in tough races is important to you, I am asking you to make a contribution before the final quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign to help make that happen.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3865?refcode=em260913&t=1&akid=2503%2E135344%2EYSgcTg)

The Daily Caller News Foundation's September 3 report, "How the Left Is Taking Over America's Reddest State," describes exactly what happened in Wyoming's August 18 primary. There was no Democratic wave -- none was needed. What occurred instead was a well-funded machine of donors, business interests, and establishment PACs running left-leaning Republicans behind conservative branding, and winning decisively.
**The Machine Worked**
In July, the PAC Common Sense Republicans for Wyoming released a 2026 Republican Primary Voter Guide endorsing Eric Barlow for governor, Robert Short for secretary of state, and three House candidates running against sitting Freedom Caucus members. Co-founder Emily Madden touted that 29 of the PAC's 34 endorsed candidates won their races. Barlow crushed Trump-backed Megan Degenfelder, 45.1% to 29.7%, and Short won as well. In America's reddest state, the primary is the election -- and the left-of-center faction just captured it.
**Branding vs. Record**
The article's most important point concerns how this victory was sold. Barlow's campaign presented him as a "mainstream conservative Republican." His legislative record tells a different story. As the Freedom Caucus has documented, Barlow consistently supported ever-growing state spending, voted against state sovereignty measures, sponsored progressive legislation, and as Speaker presided over the 2020 special session during Gov. Gordon's COVID lockdowns -- a session that failed to protect the rights of the people of Wyoming. That is not a conservative record; it is a big-government record wearing a cowboy hat.
**The Money Trail**
Barlow's campaign shattered Wyoming fundraising records, raising more than $1.65 million -- fueled by a coalition of donors, business groups, and PACs united less by conservative principle than by opposition to the Freedom Caucus. The PAC's own literature attacked Freedom Caucus funding as "out of state," yet the coalition financing Barlow and his allies was itself a national-scale operation. Money beat message, and the "common sense" label did the rest.
**What Wyoming Lost**
The stakes were real. Wyoming's Freedom Caucus was the first in the nation to hold a majority in a statehouse, and it delivered: a steep property tax cut, a ban on diversity programs in government, and most of its legislative priorities enacted. Those achievements came from legislators who answered to voters, not to chambers of commerce. Now many of those members have lost their seats to better-funded opponents, and Wyoming's policy direction will shift accordingly -- toward higher spending, softer conservatism, and an establishment comfortable with the status quo.
**The Lesson**
Nicole Silverio's closing warning is the one conservatives everywhere should heed. The Wyoming playbook -- rebrand moderates as "mainstream conservatives," outspend the grassroots in primaries, and let the deep-red general election do the rest -- is fully portable to any Republican state. If conservatives sit out primaries, cede the airwaves, and let coalition money define the terms, they will lose their states without ever seeing a Democrat's name on the winning ballot. Wyoming proves the strategy works. The question is whether other red states will wake up in time.
The Daily Caller report is accurate, timely, and necessary. Wyoming's takeover wasn't hidden -- it was simply laundered through Republican labels (NERINO TM). Agreeing with the article isn't optional for anyone who watched the results; it's the only honest reading of them.

Derek, have you heard the news?
I’m teaming up with the Democratic National Committee to bring a grassroots supporter like _you_ to Washington, DC for a personal tour of one of my very favorite spots here — the Air and Space Museum.
**[DONATE $7, or ANY AMOUNT, TO ENTER](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-Kelly-sweepstakes-2026?refcode=em_20260913_9093_fr&amount=7&refcode2=9093_22930333_iiz5ui&akid=9093%2E22930333%2Eiiz5ui)**

So I’m counting on this team today. Your donation to the DNC not only gives you a chance to win this once-in-a-lifetime experience, but it also helps Democrats build a people-powered opposition movement capable of standing up to Trump and creating change.

clean_body: Annie Andrews is the most radical Democrat South Carolina has ever nominated. President Trump and I need you to step up. | Peter, President Trump encouraged me to run. That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. President Trump is with me in this fight, and he's counting on us to stop South Carolina from sending the most extreme Democrat in the country to the United States Senate. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. I'm ready for the fight, and I'm all in for the United States Senate. But Hollywood and liberal donors from all over the country are lining up to turn South Carolina blue. We must stop the blue wave from coming into South Carolina. My opponent has already raised $13 million, and President Trump and I need you by my side to close that gap. She has the national Democrat machine behind her. What I don't have in war chests, Annie Andrews backs ALL of the Democrats’ radical agenda. No one in South Carolina has fought harder to push gender transition procedures on confused kids than she has. Gun control. Government-run health care. Abortion up until the moment of birth. This agenda is not right for South Carolina. We’re running out of time to combat this agenda. We have less than 8 weeks left before Election Day. Every dollar raised between now and November 3rd determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. subject: My son is buried in Section 60 of Arlington National Cemetery.

body:
Last week, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington later this month.
#
Peter,
My name is Karen Meredith, and I am a Gold Star mother. My son is one of more than 400,000 buried at Arlington National Cemetery.
My only child, 1LT Ken Ballard, joined the Army after graduating high school in 1995. As an Army granddaughter, Army daughter, Army sister, and Army mom, I couldn't have been more proud of his decision.
My son deployed to Iraq in May of 2003, and 384 days later he was killed while fighting an Iranian-backed militia in Najaf. He had been scheduled to return home one month earlier, but his tour was extended.
For families like mine, Arlington is more than a cemetery. It is where Ken is at eternal peace. It is a place an entire country comes to express its gratitude for a debt that cannot be repaid.
Donald Trump wants to destroy that peace. Last week, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington later this month.
Trump never served. He called my son and all who served alongside him “suckers” and “losers." He trampled the graves of the fallen in Section 60 for a campaign photo opportunity. That same man would use their graves as the backdrop for his own vanity project.
The indignity of this arch is difficult to put into words, but I am grateful to have an outlet for resisting it in my work with VoteVets. They are building a nationwide mobilization against this arch, and I’d be grateful if you could contribute to support them.

name: Ryan Busse
subject: I worked in the firearms industry for over 25 years. Now, I’m working with Gabby Giffords to fight for decency and responsibility.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I’ve had enough.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=1&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)
---
My name is Ryan Busse. For more than 25 years, I worked as a firearms executive who helped build one of the world’s most iconic gun companies.
When I first started, the gun industry was a different place. It was a place where people like me could still advocate for responsibility and decency.
But over time, I saw firsthand how the gun industry changed. It gave up its values to stoke fear and extremism. The NRA entertained dangerous conspiracy theories — including attempts to undermine our democracy.
**I had enough. Now, I am working alongside Gabby Giffords to hold the gun industry accountable and help save our country.**
[**Before I share more, can you make a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue their fight? The November elections are in just a few weeks, and your donations will be put to work winning the most competitive of races.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=2&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=3&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)**
Growing up on a ranch, my dad taught me to shoot at a young age. He instilled in me both a love of shooting and a deep sense of responsibility. I still shoot and hunt with my own boys any chance I get and I believe in our rights to do so.
The way I use guns hasn’t changed. What _has_ changed is the NRA.
The NRA was founded to teach firearm safety and promote hunter education. _It’s given all that up._
Now, it’s a tool for extremists to push their agenda and undermine even the most basic and commonsense regulations like background checks. They spend millions of dollars every year lobbying lawmakers to bend to their will — even though a majority of gun-owning Americans support these same commonsense solutions.
This isn’t okay. And it doesn’t have to be this way.
**Since leaving the industry, I have joined forces with Gabby Giffords to continue our fight back against the radicalization of the gun lobby.**
GIFFORDS has worked to build a national coalition of grassroots supporters committed to advancing commonsense gun safety laws. With your support, we can continue countering the NRA’s lies.
[**If you’re able, please contribute $10 or more to power GIFFORDS PAC’s work. Grassroots support makes a big difference in this work, and our fight cannot wait.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=4&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)
